lines.3: 「What happened to all that confidence? Don't make that face--smile, Samesuga!」
lines.4: 「If you've lost the will to fight, go see the stars!」

lines.10: 「Good. That would be wise. Not to worry--I have an entertaining diversion planned for tonight.」

lines.13: 「...So all we did today was more odd jobs around the school?」
lines.14: This camp wasn't fun at all.
lines.15: 「Now, now. I believe the director has an announcement meant to reward you all for your hard work.」
